content: To understand the influence of paragraph lengths to our paragraph-level models, we divide paragraphs in the PDTB test set into several subsets based on the number of DUs in a paragraph, and then evaluate our proposed models on each subset separately. From Figure 4 , we can see that our paragraph-level models (the latter three) overall outperform DU-pair baselines across all the subsets. As expected, the paragraph-level models achieve clear performance gains on long paragraphs (with more than 5 DUs) by extensively modeling mutual influences of DUs in a paragraph. But somewhat surprisingly, the paragraph-level models achieve noticeable performance gains on short paragraphs (with 2 or 3 DUs) as well. We hypothesize that by learning more appropriate discourse-aware DU representations in long paragraphs, our paragraph-level models reduce bias of using DU representations in predicting discourse relations, which benefits discourse relation prediction in short paragraphs as well.
